summary_1line: Rama laments Sita’s absence while describing the beauty of spring at Lake Pampa; Lakshmana consoles him and urges determined action against Ravana.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama stands on the bank of Lake Pampa filled with blooming lotuses, gazing sorrowfully over the sparkling water while Lakshmana listens beside him.
A peacock spreads its jeweled tail and dances on a forest plateau while the peahen follows, as Rama watches in anguish remembering Sita.
Wind scatters flower petals through the forest as bees swarm and trees bend in bloom around the shimmering Pampa lake.
